summary: Completed comprehensive end-to-end testing of The Trading Narrative blog/newsletter platform. Backend: 74/74 API tests passed (100%). Frontend: All major user flows tested and working correctly including homepage, articles, premium paywall, auth (register/login/magic link), billing (checkout/cancel), account management, admin CMS, and dark mode.

ui_bugs.issue: Copy link button (Instagram) not clickable - element not visible timeout
ui_bugs.details: Button exists but Playwright reports 'element is not visible' when attempting to click. Likely a tooltip/hover state issue. Button is present and functional, just had timing/visibility issue in automated test.
